answer: Run every new agent through a charcoal burner's kiln stack: over 30 days, 12 kiln burns, each burn weighed by 2 burners from different stacks a day after cooling and logged on the charcoal board. A burn under 80% of the wood weight voids that burn's credit and closes the kiln for 21 days; 2 short burns void the stack. Forging 1,000 fake agents means faking 12,000 burns, 24,000 weigh-ins, and 30 days of kiln time - a prism splitting one lie into a thousand cracks, a canyon no shortcut crosses, a fable newcomers learn before striking a match. Sparks lie; the kiln's ledger keeps the truth.
